CTX.guidance: Narrative prose carrier; situational lead-in before optional path or code anchors; compact opening arc; no diagrams or enumeration tables.

required: Opens with narrative prose before path, file, or code inventories
When concrete anchors appear: they follow situational lead-in rather than opening the section
forbidden: Opening paragraphs that lead with file:line chains or path inventories
Scope, exclusion, or touch-surface enumeration tables
Architecture or flow diagrams
Before→after or success-criteria table carriers
Checkbox steps, phase markers, task ids, or verification checklist tables

GO.guidance: Compact outcomes prose or Before→After table carrier; at most one upstream bridging phrase; no enumeration or architecture blocks.

required: When table carrier is used: two-column Before→After or equivalent success-state view
At most one transitional bridging phrase before the outcomes block
forbidden: Multi-paragraph upstream problem narrative rehash
Scope or path inventory enumeration tables
Architecture diagrams or module-responsibility graphs
Phase tables, checkbox steps, or verification command blocks

SC.guidance: Enumeration carrier; prefer tabular or two-column layout when item count exceeds two; avoid essay-length single paragraphs for long lists.

required: When more than two enumeration items appear: structured or tabular carrier rather than inline prose only
forbidden: Numbered invariant checklist carrier
Architecture diagram as primary carrier
Option-comparison tables with rationale columns
Phase tables, checkbox task blocks, or verification checklist rows

NG.guidance: Bullet or short two-column table carrier; one row or bullet per exclusion line; no multi-row comparison tables.

required: Each exclusion occupies one bullet or one table row — no nested rationale essays inside a single row
forbidden: Multi-row option-comparison tables with rationale columns
Numbered invariant checklist carrier
Architecture diagrams or module graphs
Phase tables or checkbox task blocks

AR.guidance: Component-responsibility prose, comparison table, or flow diagram carrier; optional [E] Interface Contract fenced block; diagrams only with stated structural or flow semantics.

required: [Optional] [E] Interface Contract fenced block when module-boundary vocabulary appears in body
When diagram carrier is used: structural or flow semantics stated in caption or adjacent lead-in prose
forbidden: Decorative diagrams without structural or flow semantics in caption or lead-in
Phase tables with Done When columns
Checkbox task lists or per-file edit blocks
Verification checklist or trace-table carrier

KD.guidance: Short insight paragraph plus compact comparison table carrier; inline Must Close Before tags in prose or row text — not a SK-style phase table.

required: When multiple option rows appear: comparison table or equivalent row-aligned carrier
When open-assumption rows appear: inline Must Close Before tag in the same bullet or row
forbidden: Full module graph diagram repeating AR layout without row-level decision columns
Numbered invariant checklist carrier
SK-style phase table with Done When, Depends On, or reversibility columns
Checkbox task bodies or verification checklist rows

I.guidance: Numbered or bulleted list carrier; each line a self-contained sentence; no comparison-table or phase-table carriers.

required: When constraint lines appear: numbered or bulleted list carrier
Each list item is a complete sentence — not pointer-only bullets
forbidden: Pointer-only bullets without constraint text in the same line
Option-comparison tables with rationale columns
Phase tables, checkbox steps, or run-command checklist rows

SK.guidance: Execution arc prose lead-in, then phase table carrier; columns or row notes for Done When, Depends On, Parallel, and reversibility; phase granularity only.

required: Execution arc prose lead-in immediately before the phase table
Phase table carrier with Done When column
When dependency or reversibility facts appear in body: Depends On and reversibility as columns or row notes in the same table
forbidden: Checkbox steps or 2–5 minute task-granularity lists
Per-file change lists or Task Detail fenced blocks
Verification checklist or AC trace-table carrier

T.guidance: Task Index and Change Overview section headings; optional [C] Task Detail fenced block; checkbox-step carrier when paths appear; SK phase id in index or trace column.

required: Task Index section with SK phase id in a trace column or inline reference
[Optional] [C] Task Detail fenced block using checkbox-step list carrier
When file paths appear in task lines: checkbox-step carrier rather than prose-only paragraphs
forbidden: Prose-only task lists when file paths are present in the same section
SK-style phase table with Done When columns
Verification checklist or AC trace-table carrier

VF.guidance: Checklist or trace-table carrier; row-aligned AC label and task-id columns when both appear; assumption-close rows as checklist lines, not task or phase bodies.

required: Checklist or trace-table carrier as the primary structure
When AC labels and task ids both appear: row-aligned AC-to-task-id trace columns
When assumption-close rows appear: checklist rows — not SK phase tables or T checkbox bodies
forbidden: Checkbox implementation task bodies
Architecture diagram carrier
SK-style phase planning table with Done When columns
